texto:
Smartphones are a big part of our daily lives. Many people cannot imagine a day without their phone. We use them to connect with friends and family, share photos, and send messages. It is easy to call someone who lives far away or see what our friends are doing on social media. This technology helps us feel closer to people, even when we are not in the same place.

But smartphones do more than just connect us. We use many different apps for daily tasks. For example, people use maps on their phone to find new places, so they don't get lost. Others read the news or learn a new language with educational apps. These tools are very useful and can save us a lot of time. Before smartphones, people needed different objects like a camera, a map, and a newspaper.

It is important to remember to be careful. Spending too much time on our phones is not always good, so we need to find a balance.

preguntas.pregunta: According to the text, which of the following is NOT mentioned as a use for smartphones?
preguntas.explicacion: La respuesta correcta es C porque el texto nunca menciona jugar videojuegos. The text lists several uses for smartphones, but 'playing video games' is not one of them. Las otras opciones son incorrectas porque sí se mencionan en el texto: A se menciona en 'We use them to connect with friends and family', B en 'learn a new language with educational apps', D en 'people use maps on their phone to find new places', y E en 'share photos'.

preguntas.pregunta: What can be inferred from the last paragraph?

opciones.A: Smartphones are only good for our health.
opciones.B: People should never use their smartphones.
opciones.C: Using a smartphone can have negative effects.
opciones.D: The text says phones are better than books.
opciones.E: Finding a balance is very easy for everyone.

preguntas.explicacion: La inferencia correcta es C. El último párrafo advierte que debemos ser cuidadosos. The text states, 'Spending too much time on our phones is not always good, so we need to find a balance.' Esto implica que el uso excesivo puede tener consecuencias negativas. The other options are incorrect: A es lo contrario de lo que se sugiere, B es una recomendación demasiado extrema, D compara los teléfonos con los libros, algo que no se hace en el texto, y E asume que encontrar un equilibrio es fácil, lo cual no se menciona.
